method: Developer-authored synthetic benchmark. Reference result values compared within 0.02 AED; column positions and counts matter, row order ignored. Clarification cases scored by status only; clarification quality is not automatically established. Not independent. Development cases informed prompts; post-development cases were added after those changes.

cases.question: How many orders were cancelled in 2025?

result.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

payload.approach: This query counts the number of orders with a status of 'cancelled' and an order date within the 2025 calendar year.
